applicant_utility.summary: This is an automatic 20% tuition discount, not a cash stipend, so there is nothing to 'apply' for separately — your only real action is securing an eligible RMIT offer for a Bachelor or Masters by Coursework starting from a 2026 intake while holding citizenship of India, Sri Lanka, Bangladesh, Bhutan, Nepal or Pakistan. Confirm your exact program is on the eligible list before you enrol, because the reduction only attaches to eligible programs. Keep your grades up: RMIT reviews academic progress each Semester Two and can cancel next year's reduction if you fall behind, and the discount cannot be stacked on top of another RMIT or Australia Awards tuition scholarship.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Citizens of India, Sri Lanka, Bangladesh, Bhutan, Nepal or Pakistan already targeting an eligible RMIT Bachelor or Masters by Coursework offer for a 2026 intake.

Holding another RMIT-funded or Australia Awards tuition scholarship (a scholarship loan may still be OK)
Losing the reduction in a later year for unsatisfactory academic progress
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Everything except 20% of tuition: the remaining 80% of tuition, living costs, Overseas Student Health Cover, visa fees, flights and accommodation are all self-funded.

official.description: The Flinders International Postgraduate Research Scholarship (FIPRS) is a Flinders University award that supports international students to commence full-time higher-degree-by-research study for the first time, paying international tuition fees and providing a tax-free stipend. Flinders states the award is highly competitive and, for visa purposes, is not a Commonwealth Sponsored Scholarship. Applicants for the AGRTPS are automatically considered for the FIPRS.
official.program_type: University-funded international higher degree by research scholarship
official.english_requirement: Must satisfy the English Language Proficiency Requirements for HDR Candidature; English test results must be valid until 31 March 2027, or the scholarship application is deemed ineligible.

applicant_utility.summary: This is a genuinely full package — Flinders pays your international tuition plus a $36,061-a-year tax-free stipend (2026 rate) and up to $1,485 toward relocation and airfares — so core study costs are largely covered, but only a handful are awarded each year. The 2027 international round closed 18 June 2026, so you are really preparing for the next round that opens around late April. The two things people most often get wrong: you must secure a supervisor's written agreement before applying (no supervisor means automatic exclusion), and your English test must stay valid until 31 March 2027. Because it is scored on up to five publications, candidates without a publication record are, in Flinders' words, unlikely to be competitive.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Overseas (non-Australian, non-New Zealand) applicants starting their first full-time research doctorate or masters at Flinders who already have a supervisory contact and published outputs.

common_rejection_risks: Applying without a secured supervisor (explicitly excludes you from AGRTPS/FIPRS consideration)
Publications missing coversheets or with no URL — they will not be counted
